decisions.choice: Accepted the documented fallback for the theme's fonts. Figtree and IBM Plex Mono are not loaded, so text renders in ui-sans-serif/system-ui.
options: Load Figtree with next/font/google and point --ult-font-sans at its generated family
Self-host the font files and add @font-face
decisions.why: The guidance allows loading the faces or accepting the fallback. Loading them needs a host other than the public one for this run, or an edit to the generated theme's font token.

decisions.choice: Mode follows the system preference: no data-theme attribute on <html> and no Theme Mode component or toggle.
options: Install @ultima/theme-mode and add a stored mode switch
Pin data-theme to dark or light
decisions.why: The guidance says not to add a separate mode switch for the theme artifact, and the brief asks only that both modes use the brand theme. I verified both modes by setting data-theme and by emulating the system preference.

decisions.choice: The stock list is a vertical ToggleGroup with single selection, one Item per pantry item.
options: A list of ghost Buttons with aria-pressed
Table rows, each with a View button
decisions.why: It is the pattern Ultima's own list-and-record block uses. It provides pressed state, roving arrow-key focus and pressed styling, so the screen writes no ARIA or key handling of its own.

decisions.choice: Kept ToggleGroup's default selected appearance (a raised item on a sunken track) rather than restyling the selected row in the brand accent.
options: Override the Item style to accent-subtle/accent-text, including the nested pressed-hover state
decisions.why: The guidance says to prefer the component's own states over overrides. The accent shows elsewhere: the primary Button, the focus ring and the brand label.

decisions.choice: Category uses the portalled Select inline in the form. The form is not in a Dialog.
options: Open the whole donation form in a Dialog
decisions.why: It keeps the form visible beside the list at the intake desk. Select portals to body, which the root CSS theme reaches. Keyboard open, Escape and focus return were verified.

decisions.choice: Layout sizes the app owns go in src/components/pantry/screen.stylex.ts: --app-size-content-max 72rem and --app-size-detail-min 10rem. The 48rem breakpoint is a named module constant in pantry.tsx.
options: Application defineVars module for the sizes
Derive the sizes from Ultima space tokens with calc(), as CRM 01 does
Avoid fixed sizes and use fractional grid columns only
decisions.why: The brief allows lengths only in theme and token modules. The Product semantic tokens lesson puts application sizes in a namespaced defineVars module, and the principles allow breakpoints as module constants.

review.notes: No documentation rendering, data-link decoding or JavaScript-bundle extraction. All five guides and three complete lesson bundles were fetched over HTTP. Guessed component Markdown URLs returned 404; curl of the human Select route returned its SPA shell. The agent used llms.txt APIs, installed source and public CRM registry JSON. Theme Studio was rendered by the harness. Production, check, lint and raw-paint assertions passed. Font removal and route-type regeneration reproduce #811. The Chromium socket failure required the cached headless shell. The repeated install flag is a recorded operator mistake. Deleting the unused setup-check page follows the starter comment permitting replacement. Every self-reported decision uses documented alternatives, product choices or the named media-condition exception, so none is counted. No operator edited the application.
